name: Scuba Santa in Deerfield Beach
host: City of Deerfield Beach Parks and Recreation
paras: The City of Deerfield Beach Parks and Recreation Department lists Scuba Santa on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9 AM to noon. The city calls it a family friendly event for all ages.

Children and adults can scuba dive underwater with Scuba Santa and have a picture taken with him. The city asks guests to come in their favorite holiday style and swim suits for the underwater photo. The city page does not print a venue address or a price.
tip: Pack swim suits and a holiday accessory for the underwater picture.
